digests.title: TLDR Daily Digest
digests.tagline: AI, IT, Web Dev, InfoSec, DevOps, Design

stories.headline: Anthropic Releases Claude Haiku 5.5
stories.blurb: Anthropic has launched its fastest and cheapest model to date, slashing costs by 75% compared to Haiku 4.5 to capture high-volume, cost-sensitive enterprise workflows.

stories.headline: OpenAI Launches Ultrafast Mode for GPT-6.1 Sol
stories.blurb: OpenAI is rolling out an 'Ultrafast' mode for its Sol model, delivering near-Astra intelligence at eight times the speed of Sol Standard to power real-time, high-speed API workflows.

stories.headline: Google Unveils Autonomous Gemini Agents for Enterprise
stories.blurb: Google introduced a universal Gemini agent capable of managing multi-step workflows, coding, and media creation across Google Workspace and enterprise directories.

stories.headline: ChatGPT Debuts Dynamic 'Intelligent UI' Interface
stories.blurb: OpenAI has launched a highly visual, adaptive interface that replaces standard text with interactive charts, diagrams, and task-specific widgets.

stories.headline: Compromised Tensorlake npm Package Holds Revoked Tokens Hostage
stories.blurb: A malicious version of the tensorlake npm package steals developer credentials at installation and deploys a background service that wipes the user's home directory if the stolen GitHub token is revoked.

stories.headline: Critical React Server Components Flaw Enables Next.js DoS
stories.blurb: A vulnerability in React 19 allows attackers to trigger quadratic overhead during FormData rebuilding, completely blocking the Node.js event loop with a single sub-megabyte POST request.

stories.headline: AWS Open-Sources Strands Box to Contain AI Agents
stories.blurb: AWS has released Strands Box, an open-source sandbox that uses macOS Seatbelt containment and custom policy configurations to restrict risky AI agent commands and file deletions.

stories.headline: Legacy Cerner Servers Breach Exposes 20 Million Health Records
stories.blurb: A major security breach on non-migrated legacy Oracle Health servers has exposed the personal and medical data of nearly 20 million patients.

stories.headline: Anthropic Launches Cyber Mission with Free OSS Vulnerability Scanning
stories.blurb: Anthropic is deploying its frontier models to protect critical infrastructure and offering open-source maintainers free, automated vulnerability scanning with ready-to-use fixes.

stories.headline: Internet Root DNS Keys Set to Rollover on October 11
stories.blurb: The internet's DNS root is scheduled to switch to its new trust anchor, KSK-2024, meaning improperly configured validating resolvers could fail to resolve domains.

stories.headline: Let's Encrypt Cuts SSL Certificate Lifetimes to 64 Days
stories.blurb: Beginning in February 2027, Let's Encrypt will reduce certificate validity periods from 90 to 64 days, potentially disrupting legacy automated renewal setups that do not support modern ACME specifications.

stories.headline: SAP Integrates Stablecoin Settlement Directly into Enterprise ERP
stories.blurb: SAP has partnered with Circle and Tereina to launch SAP Pay, allowing multinational corporations to natively settle invoices with USDC and EURC stablecoins across 89 global payment corridors.
